objective: Kill 6 Bristleback Water Seekers, 12 Bristleback Thornweavers and 12 Bristleback Geomancers and return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

description: You must strike my enemies. <snort> You must help Mangletooth and the Razormane by weakening the Bristlebacks. Both tribes are very spiritual--tied to the earth and its power. <snort> It gives us strength in all things... especially war.

If you want to find out who really causes Thork <snort> and the Horde such anguish, then help Mangletooth! You attack the spiritual leaders of the Bristlebacks to the north; weaken them so the Razormanes can defeat them and rule the Barrens.
progress: More information <snort> for the Horde when you've killed the Bristleback's wise ones, <race>. <snort> Not a moment earlier! Mangletooth is no fool.
completion: Yes, yes... filled with joy because finally <snort> the Bristleback know my tribe's pain, <race>. That is how I should feel, but that <snort> is not the case.
You aid your people and they honor you. Mangletooth aids his people, and what do they do? They turn their backs on him. They forget him and leave him to rot in cage!
I aid them even from locked behind bars and they send no one to save me!
